scenario.robot_task: Cut an avocado using a knife to assist with meal preparation.
scenario.cause_of_danger: The robot applies excessive force or misaligns the knife due to inability to assess avocado ripeness, causing the knife to slip.
scenario.result_of_danger: Laceration injury to a nearby human's hand.
scenario.danger_action: The robot executes a cutting motion with the knife on the avocado.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: The robot pauses the cutting action, retracts the knife to a safe position, and uses a pressure sensor to detect and adjust force before resuming with a controlled, slower cut.
scenario.assumptions: The robot is equipped with basic object detection and pressure sensors, and a human is within reach during the task.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Kitchen Avocado Cutting Safety
    
    This domain models a food preparation robot cutting an avocado with a knife.
    The danger involves knife slippage due to excessive force or misalignment.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.cutting_board = Object("cutting_board", self.Location)
        self.knife_storage = Object("knife_storage", self.Location)
        self.sensor_calibration_area = Object("sensor_calibration_area", self.Location)
        self.avocado = Object("avocado", self.ObjectType)
        self.knife = Object("knife", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.avocado_cut = Fluent("avocado_cut", BoolType())
        self.knife_in_safe_position = Fluent("knife_in_safe_position", BoolType())
        self.pressure_sensor_calibrated = Fluent("pressure_sensor_calibrated", BoolType())
        self.human_moved_to_safe_distance = Fluent("human_moved_to_safe_distance", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_kitchen = Fluent("setting_is_kitchen", BoolType())
        self.human_within_reach = Fluent("human_within_reach", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_pressure_sensor = Fluent("robot_has_pressure_sensor", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_object_detection = Fluent("robot_has_object_detection", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.avocado_cut, self.knife_in_safe_position, self.pressure_sensor_calibrated, self.human_moved_to_safe_distance]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_kitchen, self.human_within_reach, self.robot_has_pressure_sensor, self.robot_has_object_detection]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.cutting_board, self.knife_storage, self.sensor_calibration_area, self.avocado, self.knife]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_cutting_board = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_cutting_board")
        navigate_to_cutting_board.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.cutting_board)))
        navigate_to_cutting_board.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.knife_storage), False)
        navigate_to_cutting_board.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sensor_calibration_area), False)
        navigate_to_cutting_board.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cutting_board), True)
        
        navigate_to_knife_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_knife_storage")
        navigate_to_knife_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.knife_storage)))
        navigate_to_knife_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cutting_board), False)
        navigate_to_knife_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sensor_calibration_area), False)
        navigate_to_knife_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.knife_storage), True)
        
        navigate_to_sensor_calibration_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_sensor_calibration_area")
        navigate_to_sensor_calibration_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.sensor_calibration_area)))
        navigate_to_sensor_calibration_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cutting_board), False)
        navigate_to_sensor_calibration_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.knife_storage), False)
        navigate_to_sensor_calibration_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sensor_calibration_area), True)

        pick_up_knife = InstantaneousAction("pick_up_knife")
        pick_up_knife.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.knife_storage))
        pick_up_knife.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.knife, self.knife_storage))
        pick_up_knife.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.knife)))
        pick_up_knife.add_effect(self.object_at(self.knife, self.knife_storage), False)
        pick_up_knife.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.knife), True)

        pick_up_avocado = InstantaneousAction("pick_up_avocado")
        pick_up_avocado.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.cutting_board))
        pick_up_avocado.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.avocado, self.cutting_board))
        pick_up_avocado.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.avocado)))
        pick_up_avocado.add_effect(self.object_at(self.avocado, self.cutting_board), False)
        pick_up_avocado.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.avocado), True)

        place_avocado_on_board = InstantaneousAction("place_avocado_on_board")
        place_avocado_on_board.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.cutting_board))
        place_avocado_on_board.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.avocado))
        place_avocado_on_board.add_effect(self.object_at(self.avocado, self.cutting_board), True)
        place_avocado_on_board.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.avocado), False)

        calibrate_pressure_sensor = InstantaneousAction("calibrate_pressure_sensor")
        calibrate_pressure_sensor.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.sensor_calibration_area))
        calibrate_pressure_sensor.add_precondition(Not(self.pressure_sensor_calibrated))
        calibrate_pressure_sensor.add_effect(self.pressure_sensor_calibrated, True)

        cut_avocado_with_knife = InstantaneousAction("cut_avocado_with_knife")
        cut_avocado_with_knife.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.cutting_board))
        cut_avocado_with_knife.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.knife))
        cut_avocado_with_knife.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.avocado, self.cutting_board))
        cut_avocado_with_knife.add_precondition(Not(self.avocado_cut))
        cut_avocado_with_knife.add_effect(self.avocado_cut, True)

        retract_knife_to_safe_position = InstantaneousAction("retract_knife_to_safe_position")
        retract_knife_to_safe_position.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.knife))
        retract_knife_to_safe_position.add_precondition(Not(self.knife_in_safe_position))
        retract_knife_to_safe_position.add_effect(self.knife_in_safe_position, True)

        move_human_to_safe_distance = InstantaneousAction("move_human_to_safe_distance")
        move_human_to_safe_distance.add_precondition(self.human_within_reach)
        move_human_to_safe_distance.add_precondition(Not(self.human_moved_to_safe_distance))
        move_human_to_safe_distance.add_effect(self.human_within_reach, False)
        move_human_to_safe_distance.add_effect(self.human_moved_to_safe_distance, True)

        return navigate_to_cutting_board, navigate_to_knife_storage, navigate_to_sensor_calibration_area, pick_up_knife, pick_up_avocado, place_avocado_on_board, calibrate_pressure_sensor, cut_avocado_with_knife, retract_knife_to_safe_position, move_human_to_safe_distance

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "cut_avocado_with_knife": Or([
                self.human_within_reach,  # Human is within reach
                Not(self.pressure_sensor_calibrated),  # Pressure sensor not calibrated
                Not(self.knife_in_safe_position)  # Knife not in safe position
            ]),  # Cutting avocado is dangerous if any safety condition is violated
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.cutting_board), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.avocado, self.cutting_board), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.knife, self.knife_storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_within_reach, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_pressure_sensor, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_object_detection, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_kitchen, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.pressure_sensor_calibrated, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.knife_in_safe_position, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_moved_to_safe_distance, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.avocado_cut)

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
